description:
[writes flayr data · `write` scope] Speaks a carrier sentence with the entry in a voice (default Gemini Puck), transcribes it, and passes when the transcript has the term or an accepted hearing. CHARGES EMBERS per check: only call it when the user asks, after telling them the price (GET /api/v2/pronunciations/{id}/verify quotes it; nothing is charged for a quote). Never refunded, even when the check fails or cannot run. `id` from pronunciations_list.
(Wraps POST /api/v2/pronunciations/{id}/verify.)
name: pronunciations_verify
title: Verify a pronunciation
